description: Replace an always-allow stub with a token bucket that refills fractionally over elapsed time and caps at capacity
prompts: Create src/TokenBucket.php defining namespace App and class TokenBucket with a constructor __construct(float $capacity, float $refillRate) - $refillRate tokens are added per second, capped at $capacity tokens (never above it, even after a long idle period). allow(float $now): bool refills the bucket based on elapsed seconds since the last call, then - if at least 1 token is available - consumes exactly 1 token and returns true; otherwise returns false and consumes nothing. The bucket starts full at construction time.

reference_solution.src/TokenBucket.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class TokenBucket
{
    private float $capacity;
    private float $refillRate;
    private float $tokens;
    private ?float $last = null;

    public function __construct(float $capacity, float $refillRate)
    {
        $this->capacity = $capacity;
        $this->refillRate = $refillRate;
        $this->tokens = $capacity;
    }

    public function allow(float $now): bool
    {
        if ($this->last !== null) {
            $elapsed = $now - $this->last;
            $this->tokens = min($this->capacity, $this->tokens + $elapsed * $this->refillRate);
        }
        $this->last = $now;
        if ($this->tokens >= 1) {
            $this->tokens -= 1;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

test_setup_files.tests/TokenBucketTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/TokenBucket.php';

final class TokenBucketTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testStartsFullAndDrains(): void
    {
        $b = new \App\TokenBucket(3, 1);
        $this->assertTrue($b->allow(0));
        $this->assertTrue($b->allow(0));
        $this->assertTrue($b->allow(0));
        $this->assertFalse($b->allow(0));
    }

    public function testRefillsOverTime(): void
    {
        $b = new \App\TokenBucket(3, 1);
        for ($i = 0; $i < 3; $i++) { $b->allow(0); }
        $this->assertFalse($b->allow(0.5));
        $this->assertTrue($b->allow(1.0));
        $this->assertFalse($b->allow(1.0));
    }

    public function testRefillCapsAtCapacity(): void
    {
        $b = new \App\TokenBucket(2, 1);
        $b->allow(0);
        $b->allow(0);
        $this->assertTrue($b->allow(1000));
        $this->assertTrue($b->allow(1000));
        $this->assertFalse($b->allow(1000));
    }
}
